strategy: The robot follows a priority-based navigation strategy where it first attempts to move toward the goal if the direction is unblocked. If the goal is not directly ahead, it checks left and right directions in order. If no goal-directed path is available, it tries to move in any unblocked direction. If all directions are blocked, it stops safely.

decisions.reason: The goal is directly ahead and the forward direction is unblocked, so the robot moves forward toward the goal.
The goal is on the left and the left direction is unblocked, so the robot turns left to face the goal.
The goal is on the right and the right direction is unblocked, so the robot turns right to face the goal.
No goal-directed path is available, but the forward direction is unblocked, so the robot moves forward.
No goal-directed path is available, but the left direction is unblocked, so the robot turns left.
No goal-directed path is available, but the right direction is unblocked, so the robot turns right.
All directions are blocked, so the robot stops safely as no further movement is possible.

stop_condition: The robot must stop when all directions (front, left, and right) are blocked, ensuring safe stopping as per the safe_stop requirement.
